comment: create-pr: when only the branch was pushed (--no-open, auto-open off, a dry run, or a provider refusal) the reminder reads 'no PR opened: <why>' (state pushed) instead of 'PR created'; --no-open and auto-open off also set pr_open_skipped (a dry run keeps dry_run, a refusal pr_open_error); a --no-open re-run still reports an existing PR
